get.description:
Returns a list of providers in subscriber’s private network. The response contains provider contact details and the vendor ID.
Visit ServiceChannel University to find out more about the [vendor ID](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/571835102/Managing+Private+Notes+Rating+and+Vendor+ID#ManagingPrivateNotes,Rating,andVendorID-VendorID).

No input parameters are required.

200.description: The list of providers is in the response.

500.description: Something went wrong, and the server was unable to complete your request.

post.description:
Adds the specified provider to the *Do Not Dispatch* list, which prevents dispatching new work orders to this provider.
You can remove providers from the *Do Not Dispatch* list by using the [DELETE /doNotDispatch/removeProvider/{providerId}](https://developer.servicechannel.com/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/DoNotDispatch/DoNotDispatch_RemoveProvider) method. To retrieve the list of providers with the *Do Not Dispatch* flag, send the [GET /DoNotDispatch/getProviders](https://developer.servicechannel.com/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/DoNotDispatch/DoNotDispatch_GetProviders) request.
Refer to ServiceChannel University to learn [how to manage “Do Not Dispatch” providers](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/812548755/Managing+Do+Not+Dispatch+Providers).

parameters.name: doNotDispatchReason
parameters.description: (*Optional*) Reason for assigning a provider the *Do Not Dispatch* status.

200.description: The provider is successfully added to the **Do Not Dispatch** list.

400.description: The request is not accepted due to bad syntax, missing parameters, insufficient data, etc.

500.description: The server was unable to complete the request due to an internal error.

delete.description:
Removes the specified provider from the *Do Not Dispatch* list. You can remove one provider at a time.
To add a provider to this list, send the [POST /doNotDispatch/addProvider/{providerId}](https://developer.servicechannel.com/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/DoNotDispatch/DoNotDispatch_AddProvider) request.
Refer to ServiceChannel University to learn [how to manage “Do Not Dispatch” providers](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/812548755/Managing+Do+Not+Dispatch+Providers).

200.description: The provider is successfully removed from the **Do Not Dispatch** list.

400.description: The request is not accepted due to bad syntax, missing parameters, insufficient data, etc.

500.description: The server was unable to complete the request due to an internal error.

get.description:
Returns a list of providers included in the *Do Not Dispatch* list. Use the `trade` parameter to specify your request.
You can use the [POST /doNotDispatch/addProvider/{providerId}](https://developer.servicechannel.com/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/DoNotDispatch/DoNotDispatch_AddProvider) method to add a provider to the *Do Not Dispatch* list or the [DELETE /doNotDispatch/removeProvider/{providerId}](https://developer.servicechannel.com/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/DoNotDispatch/DoNotDispatch_RemoveProvider) method to remove a provider from it.
Refer to ServiceChannel University to learn [how to manage “Do Not Dispatch” providers](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/812548755/Managing+Do+Not+Dispatch+Providers).

parameters.name: trade
parameters.description: (*Optional*) Type of work a provider performs.

200.description: The providers included in the **Do Not Dispatch** list are in the response.

400.description: The request is not accepted due to bad syntax, missing parameters, insufficient data, etc.

500.description: The server was unable to complete the request due to an internal error.

LinkIsActive.description:
Defines whether a link between the provider and the subscriber is active:
            1 — The link between the provider and subscriber is active.
            0 — The link between the provider and subscriber is not active for one of the following reasons:
            a) The provider has accepted the client invitation, and the subscriber hasn’t accepted yet. The invitation status is *Pending*. Learn how to manage client invitations for [US-based](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCUCP/pages/2372469831/Manage+Client+Invitations) and [non-US-based](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCUCP/pages/2276492550/Managing+Client+Invitations) providers in ServiceChannel University.
            b) The subscriber has deactivated the provider.
